title: 第1课 · 九月去北京旅游最好
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 1 — 九月去北京旅游最好 · September is the best time to visit Beijing

items.zh: 总览 · What this class was about
items.en: Warm-up and review (numbers, 吃了吗, time, jobs and retirement, what you did last week, comparing temperatures), then Lesson 1 九月去北京旅游最好: why September is the best time for Beijing, when to visit the Netherlands, the new words with their radicals (猫, 眼睛), and a long list of sports. Each topic has a short explanation and example sentences; the practice tabs hold the same material for flashcards, quiz and fill-in.
晚点 is for schedules — a plane or train is delayed. 迟到 is for people — you arrive late for class or work.

items.zh: 从东京来的飞机到了吗？——不知道，晚点了。
items.py: Cóng Dōngjīng lái de fēijī dàole ma? — Bù zhīdào, wǎndiǎn le.
items.en: Has the plane from Tokyo arrived? — I don't know, it's delayed.
Telling the time: 一点 = 1:00, 一点五分 = 1:05, 一点八分 = 1:08. Careful: 一点 also means 'a little' (快一点 = a bit faster, 少一点儿 = a bit less).

items.zh: 3 · 七八岁 vs 七十八岁 · 退休
items.en: 七八岁 = about seven or eight (an estimate, Lesson 1 grammar); 七十八岁 = 78. Retirement (退休): in the Netherlands around 67–68; in China women traditionally at 55, men at 60.
see: 文化 · Culture (中荷差异 China vs Netherlands)

items.zh: 你妈妈做什么工作？——她退休了。
items.py: Nǐ māma zuò shénme gōngzuò? — Tā tuìxiū le.
items.en: What does your mother do? — She's retired.

items.zh: 在荷兰，六十七、六十八岁退休。
items.py: Zài Hélán, liùshíqī, liùshíbā suì tuìxiū.
items.en: In the Netherlands people retire at 67 or 68.

items.zh: 在中国，女的五十五岁退休。
items.py: Zài Zhōngguó, nǚ de wǔshíwǔ suì tuìxiū.

items.zh: 我的外祖母七十三岁了，还在工作。
items.py: Wǒ de wàizǔmǔ qīshísān suì le, hái zài gōngzuò.
items.en: My grandmother is 73 and still working.

items.zh: 4 · 什么都没… / 哪儿都没… / 谁都不…
items.en: Question word + 都 + 没/不 = nothing / nowhere / nobody. Use 没 for the past (last week), 不 for habits or plans (this holiday, in general).
see: 练习 · Practice (什么都没 / 哪儿都没 / 谁都不)

items.zh: 你们上个星期做了什么？——我感冒了，什么都没做。
items.py: Nǐmen shàng ge xīngqī zuòle shénme? — Wǒ gǎnmào le, shénme dōu méi zuò.
items.en: What did you do last week? — I had a cold, I did nothing.

items.zh: 我上个星期哪儿都没去。
items.py: Wǒ shàng ge xīngqī nǎr dōu méi qù.
items.en: I didn't go anywhere last week.

items.py: Qiūjià wǒ nǎr dōu bú qù.
items.en: I'm not going anywhere in the autumn break.
Comparing temperatures: A 比 B 高/低 + number + 度. Don't forget the detail — how many degrees.

items.zh: 上个星期六比这个星期六高多少度？
items.py: Shàng ge xīngqīliù bǐ zhège xīngqīliù gāo duōshao dù?
items.en: How many degrees warmer was last Saturday than this Saturday?

items.zh: 上个星期六的温度比这个星期六高三度。
items.py: Shàng ge xīngqīliù de wēndù bǐ zhège xīngqīliù gāo sān dù.
items.en: Last Saturday was three degrees warmer than this Saturday.

items.zh: 6 · 九月去北京旅游最好 — why?
items.en: When you choose when to travel, think of: 天气 (weather), 价格 (price), 人多不多 (crowds) and 食物 (food). September in Beijing: not cold, not hot; not busy; cheaper tickets.
see: 课文1 · 1. 在学校 — In the school
练习 · Practice (什么时候去……最好？)

items.zh: 九月北京天气很好，不冷也不热。
items.py: Jiǔ yuè Běijīng tiānqì hěn hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
items.en: In September the weather in Beijing is good — not cold, not hot.

items.zh: 九月人不多，机票更便宜。
items.py: Jiǔ yuè rén bù duō, jīpiào gèng piányi.
items.en: In September there are fewer people and flights are cheaper.
Your Chinese friend asks when to visit the Netherlands. The class said April: spring, lots of flowers, good weather, fresh fish.
see: 练习 · Practice (什么时候去……最好？)

items.zh: 你什么时候来荷兰最好？——四月。
items.py: Nǐ shénme shíhou lái Hélán zuì hǎo? — Sì yuè.
items.en: When is the best time to come to the Netherlands? — April.

items.zh: 四月是春天，有很多花，可以看花。
items.py: Sì yuè shì chūntiān, yǒu hěn duō huā, kěyǐ kàn huā.
items.en: April is spring; there are lots of flowers to see.

items.py: Hái kěyǐ chī xīnxiān de yú.
items.en: And you can eat fresh fish.

items.zh: 8 · Radicals: 犭 and 目 / 日
items.en: 猫 and 狗 have the animal radical 犭. 眼睛 has 目 (eye) on the left; 晴 (clear, 晴天) has the same right side but 日 (sun). Measure words: 两只猫, 三只狗; a pair is 一双: 一双眼睛, 一双手 (but 一只手), 一双鞋, 一双袜子.
see: 练习 · Practice (量词 只 / 双, radicals)

items.py: Tā yǒu yì shuāng piàoliang de yǎnjing.
items.en: It has a pair of beautiful eyes.
踢 is for football; 打 for ball games with hands or rackets (篮球, 排球, 乒乓球, 羽毛球, 台球); other sports have their own verb or none. The best-known Dutch footballer in China: 范佩西 (Van Persie).

items.en: Who is the most famous Dutch footballer?
